hooks.command: python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); r=json.dumps({'continue':False,'stopReason':'WORKFLOW GATE: delegate coding to a subagent (workflow.md Rule 2). Use the Agent tool.'}) if any(fp.endswith(e) for e in ('.cs','.xaml','.xaml.cs')) else ''; print(r) if r else None" 2>/dev/null || true
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && dotnet build MyVocaList.sln --no-restore -v q 2>&1 | tail -40

FILE=$(python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git add "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && if ! git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then git commit -m "wip: $(basename \"$FILE\")" --quiet 2>/dev/null && git push origin HEAD --quiet 2>/dev/null; fi; fi 2>/dev/null || true

echo 'CONTEXT RESTORED — Non-negotiables: (1) dotnet build after every change, fix all errors before next file. (2) Never use DisplayAlert/DisplayActionSheet/DisplayPromptAsync. (3) DevExpress-first — check devexpress-patterns.md before any UI work. (4) SafeAreaEdges=Container on all ContentPages (.NET MAUI 10). (5) Spec → Plan → Implement → Review — never skip to implementation. (6) English only in code, comments, logs, UI text. (7) After every completed task: /project:review → /project:commit (stage, commit, push).'

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && STATUS=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null) && if [ -n "$STATUS" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ Uncommitted changes detected — run /project:commit to complete the task."}'; fi

hooks.prompt:
A task just reached a terminal state. Full task context (JSON): $ARGUMENTS

Step 1 — ALWAYS (any status): append one row to Docs/task-log.md under the existing table:
`| MM/DD/YYYY | <task name/title from JSON> | <status from JSON> | <one-line outcome or reason, under 100 chars> |`
Extract status verbatim from the JSON (completed / failed / blocked / cancelled / skipped).

Step 2 — ONLY if status is 'completed' or 'done': also append ONE line to Docs/Changelog/changelog.md.
Changelog format (match existing entries exactly): `- **MM/DD/YYYY** - type - Brief description`
- Type: feat / fix / test / docs / chore / refactor / perf
- Description: under 120 chars, past tense, describes the deliverable
- Insert at the TOP of the current month's entries section (right after the `## Entries for ...` header)
- Never modify or reorder existing changelog entries
- Skip trivial completions: status-only updates or bookkeeping with no file deliverable

Write only to these two files — no other changes.
